intro.text: The.well-known/openid-configuration endpoint provides a standardized way for Third Party Providers (TPPs) to retrieve OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect configuration for a Licensed Financial Institution (LFI). This allows TPPs to discover authorization, token, and other endpoints programmatically, without hardcoding URLs.
